title: Physics analogy
script:
Momentum is why a Fast & Furious car can't stop on a dime.
Friction is why you spin out on the ice track in Mario Kart.
And conservation of energy is why Sonic the Hedgehog can't really run forever.
note: Original lesson lines for a university intro class, audience 18-34 in the United States. Uses full titles Qloo can resolve (Mario Kart, Sonic the Hedgehog) so every reference gets scored.
